Class CharacterCard

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.am23.model.cards.Card
it.polimi.ingsw.am23.model.cards.CharacterCard
Direct Known Subclasses:
ArtistCard, BuilderCard, GathererCard, HunterCard, InventorCard, ShamanCard
public abstract class CharacterCard extends Card
Abstract base class for the cards representing tribe characters. Concrete subclasses model the different archetypes (Hunter, Gatherer, Shaman, ...) and may override onAddedToTribe(Game, Player) to apply archetype specific side effects when collected.

    • onTaken

      public void onTaken(Game game, Player player)
      Hook invoked when the card is picked from the market by a player.

      Adds the character to the player's tribe and forwards the event to onAddedToTribe(Game, Player) for subclass specific behavior.

      Specified by:
      onTaken in class Card
      Parameters:
      game - the game instance the card belongs to
      player - the player who picked the card

    • onAddedToTribe

      protected void onAddedToTribe(Game game, Player player)
      Hook invoked after the character has been added to the player's tribe. Default implementation is a no-op; subclasses can override to react.

      player - the player who collected the card
